out_of_scope_pest_after_50_labels.meaning: Once field photos become familiar, the familiarity check no longer catches a pest the model was never taught. About half of the answered mite photos are still flagged as a problem (rust), about a third are wrongly called healthy.
mitigations: Officer review screen offers "different problem / not in list"; those photos stay in the not-sure lane for similar photos.
Spot-check: 1 in 10 answered photos is also queued for the officer, so errors and drift are seen.
Plot card never says a plot is disease-free; the checklist covers what photos cannot see.

demo_samples_after_50: before: 7/7 not sure; after the demo update: 3/3 healthy correct, 2/3 rust correct (1 not sure), the mite photo wrongly called healthy
